description: Retrieve the readable text content of a text item (OCR DjVuTXT or plain-text file) from the Internet Archive, with length-aware truncation and a continuation pointer for pagination. Suited for public-domain books, documents, scanned periodicals, and transcripts. Use max_chars and char_offset to page through long documents. To confirm the item has a text file first, call ia_get_item with format "DjVuTXT"; its response also gives the mediatype.

char_offset.description: Character offset to start reading from (default 0). To read the next page, add max_chars to the previous char_offset.

identifier.description: Internet Archive item identifier, e.g. "prideprejudice00aust" (Pride and Prejudice). Obtain from ia_search_items results.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return in this response. Defaults to the server-configured maximum (IA_MAX_SNAPSHOT_CHARS, typically 50 000). Lower values reduce token usage.

name: ia_get_text

char_offset.description: Character offset used for this response.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `item_not_found`: The identifier does not exist in the Internet Archive. `no_text_file`: The item exists but contains no readable text file (DjVuTXT or plain-text). `download_forbidden`: Access to this item is restricted — it is in a login-required or limited collection. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when there is more text beyond this slice. Increment char_offset by max_chars to read the next page.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned in this response.

source_file.description: Filename of the source text file fetched from the item.

text.description: The text slice starting at char_offset up to max_chars characters.

total_chars.description: Total character count of the full text file.

title: Get Internet Archive Item Text
